script.title: Piplup — A Proud Little Wave
script.description: A chubby Piplup with an oversized blue hood, white oval cheeks, sparkling eyes, a smiling yellow beak, two snowy chest buttons and a raised flipper. Three rounded toes on each foot support the figure. Its dark blue collar continues into a cape and forked tail.
